newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European bunkers rise in thin year-end.
newsitem.headline: European bunkers rise in thin year-end.

text.p: European bunker prices rose on Tuesday in a thin and final half day of the year, dealers said.
Price rises were the result of futures strength on Monday and the scarcity of suppliers. Cold weather, expected to continue until the end of the week, provided key support.
Dealers said suppliers had marked up their prices to benefit from the few last minute enquiries.
Rotterdam 380 CST was up about $2 a tonne to $115/$117 fob. One major continued to offer prompt product, but dealers said first half January deliveries were more expensive.
Mediterranean prices were up by a similar amount.
